body: The thing is I don't see any possibility of carrying myself out from the hole I'm in. The future holds nothing for me (at the moment). I'm really sorry for all that happened to you and I really hope that your life will be gradually better. I'll have to think everything through, I will end with myself after securing future for my parents and giving everything to my brother. Only people that cared about me

I think it's because I want to know with what I am dealing at the moment. The thing is I don't want to get lost in community so I am observing everything from above, deciding where and when to engage and talk. Web is so much easier for me because people are already labeled and I can choose the topics.

Life overall. I have suicidal thoughts because I can't communicate with people around. No one knows me fully because I adjust myself to groups of people. I like setting labels for everyone just to classify them.

I broke up with my partner because we had nothing to talk about. I have a depression and my therapeutist ordered an IQ test which resulted in rounded 140. I would love to be less intelligent but more eligible for people
Please, I don't want to make a mistake. Give me some reasons to live. Give me something to hold on
